# dotenv-schema

> Validate .env files against a JSON schema in Go: strict dotenv parsing, typed rules for int, bool, enum, url, duration and pattern, secret-safe messages and a generated .env.example Go module `github.com/Trysac/u275-dotenv-schema`, package `dotenvschema`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
